notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are super happy to announce that our game is now eligible for Steam Trading Cards!

If you notice on our Store page, the ugly "Profile features limited" message is not there anymore.

Cards are Available! Feel free to enjoy them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40893811/96eba2a5dba2da9017e59a9b05ee0dc29110581d.jpg



We also carefully selected our cutest backgrounds for you to unlock!
Do you want to personalize your Steam profile with an awesome artwork from Tiffy? Now you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40893811/12155a07462e1725d90f53aeba725299495e54fa.jpg


Feel free to let us know what you think or if you have any suggestions.
For updates and news follow us on:

Twitter
Steam

notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We are happy to be back with our first big update.
We paid very close attention to your feedback and we really wanted to thank you for your support! We really care about Tiffy so we are doing our best to keep her game updated & provide the best possible experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40893811/19317030bc51a08713ebcb7f37841d1bf43860dd.jpg


Anyway here are the patch notes for the update that landed a couple of days ago, It includes both fixes and new content.

New content:
- Added the 18+ version of the artwork "Luxury Tiffy"
- Added the 18+ version of the artwork "Pizza delivery Tiffy"

Fixes & Improvements:
- Major fixes to the gallery: now all the levels are fully visible (even if they don't feature a 18+ version)
- Fixed the "new dress available" notification popping too many times
- Fixed the "log" feature in the visual novel section of the game
- Fixed the color palette bug in "color mode"
- Various improvements the the "Pencil mode" section of the game
- Improved eye tracking feature for Tiffy's animated character model
- Moved the "YOU"RE A BIG BUGA!!" line to the correct category
- Fixed the nudie version of the level 5 image, which was not perfectly aligned.
- Various improvements to stability and performance

Well I think that's all!
Feel free to let us know if you have further suggestions and/or ideas. We are also discussing with Tiffy about the possibility of adding new levels every couple of months. It will depend of her schedule.

Follow us on Twitter for more news and updates!
Until our next update!
